name: Qeemat Connect – Integration for WooCommerce
author: qeematwp

sections.description:
Get your products in front of shoppers who are ready to buy.

Shoppers in Pakistan compare prices on Qeemat before they pick a store. Qeemat Connect for WooCommerce puts your products there automatically and sends those shoppers straight to your product pages. No feed files, no manual updates.

What you get

  • Get discovered. Your offers appear on Qeemat beside other stores’ prices for the same products, so shoppers searching for a product find your store.
  • Win ready-to-buy visitors. A shopper who picks your offer lands directly on your product page.
  • Set it up once. The plugin sends your prices and stock to Qeemat every day, so there is nothing to upload or keep in sync by hand.
  • Show off your best prices. Turn on the Verified Best Price badge, and it appears on the products where your price is the lowest Qeemat found.

How it works

  • Catalog sync. Once Qeemat approves your store, the plugin sends your products and variations once a day in the background, and whenever you click Export now.
  • Verified Best Price badge. Turn it on in the settings. When your price for a product is the lowest Qeemat found in Pakistan, a small badge on the product page says so and links to the price check on qeemat.com.pk. On every other product nothing is shown.

You need a free Qeemat partner account for your store. The plugin never changes your products, prices or orders.

Badge placement

By default the badge appears right after the Add to cart button. This works with classic themes, block themes and page builders such as Elementor. You can instead place it right after the price, before the Add to cart button or after the product meta, or choose Manual only and add the Qeemat Verified Best Price block or the [qeemat_badge] shortcode yourself. The badge follows the variation the shopper picks.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Qeemat (https://qeemat.com.pk/), a price comparison service for Pakistan. Nothing is sent until a shop manager clicks Connect to Qeemat in WooCommerce > Settings > Qeemat. Every request from your server carries the store’s address, its connection key and the plugin’s version.

To report a sale from our referral, Qeemat needs to know which shopper clicked your offer. For that, the plugin keeps Qeemat’s click reference in a qeemat_click cookie on your site for up to 30 days. If your cookie banner uses the WP Consent API, it waits for the shopper’s consent. Suggested privacy policy text is in Settings > Privacy.

Qeemat’s terms: https://qeemat.com.pk/terms-and-conditions
Qeemat’s partner terms: https://partner.qeemat.com.pk/terms-and-conditions
Qeemat’s privacy policy: https://qeemat.com.pk/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Qeemat and click Connect to Qeemat.
  3. Copy the connection URL, paste it into Feed settings in Qeemat’s partner portal (partner.qeemat.com.pk), and submit it for review.
  4. Once Qeemat approves your store, the first export starts by itself. The settings page shows its progress.
  5. Turn on the Verified Best Price badge in step 3 of the settings.
sections.faq:
Does Qeemat crawl my store?

No. Your store sends its catalog to Qeemat. Qeemat never calls your site, so no extra load is added.

Which products are sent?

Published simple products and variations: their link, name, a description, the price shoppers see, stock status, up to two images, rating and number of reviews, SKU, GTIN, brand and categories. A variation that accepts any value of an attribute gets its own link.

The badge does not appear where I expect it.

Pick another placement, or choose Manual only and add the block or the [qeemat_badge] shortcode, for example with Elementor’s Shortcode widget. Logged in as a shop manager, add ?qeemat_badge_debug=1 to a product page’s address to see where the badge was printed and why Qeemat showed or hid it.

Can I change how the badge looks?

Choose the light or dark style in the settings. The block also takes colours, font size and spacing. To change its markup, copy templates/badge.php to qeemat-connect/badge.php in your theme.
